sections.title: Morning Shift — Team 1 (06:30 – 14:30)
items: Equipment received: 2 x Swipe Cards, 5 sets of keys, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 2 x Bodycam.
Commencing Alpha Route. Durham Street check-in, all clear, no issues to report.
Check-in at Chemist Warehouse, Kathmandu, Macpac, Faradays, all clear.
Queen Street full sweep complete, all clear, no issues to report.
Welfare check at Britomart McDonald's, all clear.
Patrolling Commercial Bay; commencing full sweep.
Roadblock on Quay Street due to the marathon being run today; on standby showing security presence.
All clear at Quay Street at this time; heading down Gore Street.
Gore Street all clear, no issues to report.
Full sweep of Fort Street; welfare checks on Tribe Hotel and Jo and Joes, full sweep of Wilson Carpark — all clear.
Full sweep of High Street and Shortland Street, all clear.
Full sweep of Freyberg and Chancery Square, all clear.
Responded to a call from St Patrick's Cathedral regarding a trespassed individual who had returned.
Arrived on site and spoke to the individual; he complied but took a while to pack his things, so we stood by while he packed.
St Patrick's Cathedral square all clear, no further issues to report.
Patrolling Federal Street; welfare check on Rydges Hotel, no issues.
Welfare checks on 77 Convenience Store, Eighty Fed, Coffee Club, all clear.
Victoria Street full sweep complete, all clear; heading back to HQ to charge the Ops Phone, currently on 3%.
Arrived at HQ; charging the Ops Phone.
Heading back on patrol; checking on surrounding businesses.
Welfare check, all clear — large foot traffic due to the Diwali festival; heading to check in at Woolworths:
Welfare check on Woolworths, Chemist Warehouse and Real Groovy, all clear; standing by, no issues to report.
Heading to check on Elliott and Darby Street.
Welfare check, all clear; heading towards the corner of Victoria and Federal Street:

Arrived at corner of Victoria and Federal Street; welfare check on Vape Mode, 77 Convenience Store Wellesley Street, Eighty Fed, 77 Convenience Store Victoria Street and Coffee Club — no issues to report. Standing by for security presence.
Continuing welfare checks on surrounding businesses.
Welfare check, all clear; heading towards Lower Albert Street via Albert Street:
Welfare check on Good To Go Supermarket, Hollywood Cafe and Shakespeare Tavern, no issues; heading to check up on the St Patrick's Cathedral area.
Welfare check on St Patrick's Cathedral and Square, no issues to report; standing by for security presence.
Heading back on Albert Street down towards Lower Albert Street.
Arrived at Albert Mart; welfare check completed, no issues to report. Standing by for security presence.
Welfare check at Remarkable Gifts, Albert Street, completed — no issues to report.
Welfare check on Lower Albert Street Woolworths and Aotea Gifts, no issues; standing by for security presence.
Heading to check in on the Commercial Bay area and Britomart McDonald's.
Commercial Bay, Kowhai Coffee, Downtown Kebab, TK Square and Britomart McDonald's all clear; standing by for security presence.
Welfare checks from Swarovski up to HQ — all businesses clear. Heading upstairs to use the restroom, then commencing break.
Call from OPSM asking for assistance with a theft that occurred at their store; heading down towards OPSM.
Found a phone on the public seating bench in front of Glassons; the owner called the phone — awaiting her arrival to pick it up.
Owner retrieved the phone; she had been in Noel Leeming.
Arrived at OPSM; being briefed on the situation.
A male stole four Ray-Ban sunglasses worth $300 each and fled the scene in a white Mitsubishi hatchback, registration RUR854. Heading to Chemist Warehouse to ask for footage.
Retrieved a photo, though the quality is poor; heading back to OPSM to inform them.
Staff were grateful for the photo — something to show Police, who the manager was with. Standing by for security presence.
Sending the photo to Pearl's WhatsApp.
Heading to the office to wait for the incoming guards.
At the office, still waiting for the guards to arrive.
Call received from Valerie and Michael regarding a female individual (raw entry truncated; detail completed by the Afternoon Shift).
Benny arrived; heading over to the response call. Ending the morning report and rolling over to the Afternoon Shift.

sections.title: Afternoon/Evening Shift (14:30 – 22:30)
items: Equipment received: 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, 1 x Bodycam, 5 x Keys.
Arrived and briefed by Michael from Queens Ferry about a female disturbing the peace and swearing at him and customers; moving to deal with the POI.
Moved the female along towards Albert Park. (Photo on file.)
Notified Michael and Valerie; heading back to HQ.
Arrived at the office; signed Nathan and Beni in to the shift while Don updates the reports.
Don clocked off; charging the Ops Phone, which is on 8%.
Response call from Liquor City on Victoria Street regarding an intoxicated female causing a disturbance; Police were already on site before we arrived. Commencing patrol down Queen Street.
Commencing sweep of Victoria Street with a welfare check on Countdown. Incident with the vagrant in front of Countdown — standing by to assist Police if needed.
Police have now left with the vagrant; continuing patrol down Queen Street.
Full sweep of the top half of Queen Street; welfare checks from Farmers down to 2degrees, all clear. Continuing patrol down Queen Street.
Arrived at Durham Street commencing sweep; welfare check on Hazy Tiger and both Wilson carparks, no issues.

While walking down Queen Street towards Commercial Bay, approached by the Lovisa store owner requesting assistance moving a vagrant away from the storefront. Approached the male vagrant and asked him to move; he complied, no further issues.
Queen Street sweep complete; welfare checks completed, no issues:
Arrived at Commercial Bay; commencing sweep.

Full sweep of Commercial Bay completed; welfare check completed on Britomart McDonald's. Heading back to Headquarters to charge the Ops Phone due to low battery (battery was already on a low percentage when we received and attended the response call).
Arrived at HQ; charging the Ops Phone.
Full sweep of Darby Street; welfare checks on all stores within the area — Thai Foods, Pizza Club, Chicken and Fish and Chips, Mr Snacks, Celines. Continuing towards Elliott Street.
Arrived at Elliott Street; commencing sweep within the area while conducting welfare checks.
Arrived at Elliott Stables; standing by awaiting response calls (18:31–18:49).
Full sweep of Elliott Street, all clear, no issues; commencing patrol towards Victoria Street.
Arrived at Victoria Street; commencing welfare checks on Countdown and Seven Mart Convenience Store.
Full sweep of Victoria Street, all clear, no issues to report; continuing patrol down Federal Street.
Arrived at Wyndham Street; welfare checks on Chemist Warehouse and St Patricks Square.
Full sweep of St Patricks Square, all clear; welfare check on the convenience stores on Albert Street. Continuing patrol towards Commercial Bay.
Arrived at Commercial Bay; full sweep of Customs Street West, all clear. Commencing full sweep of Commercial Bay.
Full sweep of Commercial Bay completed; standing by maintaining security presence due to the increase in public activity.
Arrived at Jo & Joe; welfare check completed on Jo & Joes, with full sweeps of Customs Street East, Fort Lane and Fort Street, all clear. Heading over to Chancery Square via High Street.
Arrived at Chancery Square; commencing sweep within the area.
Full sweep of Chancery Square, all clear, no issues; standing by maintaining presence awaiting response calls.
Heard a loud commotion coming from Queen Street; heading over now.
Arrived at Queen Street — extremely high amount of public activity heading from Aotea Square to Commercial Bay.
All clear, no issues to report; heading to Headquarters for a 30-minute break.
Arrived at HQ; commencing the 30-minute break.
Break completed; standing by in the office waiting for handover.

sections.title: Night Shift (22:30 – 06:30)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 2 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio.
Standing by in the office charging the Ops Phone.
Response call from McDonald's Queen Street regarding a male vagrant sitting in front of the store; gearing up and getting ready to respond.
Arrived at the location; the male vagrant was asked to move along and complied. Standing by maintaining presence in case he returns.
Arrived at Darby Street; commencing sweep.
All clear, no issues to report; continuing patrol on Elliott Street and commencing a full sweep.
Full sweep of Elliott Street, all clear, no issues; continuing patrols up Victoria Street.
All clear on Victoria Street, no issues to report; continuing patrol towards Albert Street.
Albert Street all clear, no issues; continuing patrols down Wyndham Street towards Queen Street.
Welfare check on Q Convenience Store, Queen Street, all clear, no issues to report; continuing patrol towards Commercial Bay.
Arrived at Commercial Bay; welfare check on Britomart McDonald's.
All clear, no issues to report; commencing sweep of Commercial Bay.
All clear, no issues to report; standing by showing our presence.
Commencing patrol towards Queen Street with welfare checks on the remaining open businesses.
Full sweep of Vulcan Lane, all clear, no issues; standing by showing our presence.
Arrived at Wyndham Street; commencing sweep within the area.
Wyndham Street all clear, no issues to report; standing by at Hallensteins Queen Street maintaining presence.
All clear, no issues; continuing patrols towards Headquarters to charge the Ops Phone, on 10%.
Arrived at Durham Street; commencing sweep.
All clear, no issues to report; heading to Headquarters.
Floor checks completed; charging the Ops Phone and awaiting response calls.
Arrived on Victoria Street; standing by maintaining our presence.
Arrived at Durham Street; standing by showing our presence.
Arrived at Commercial Bay; welfare check on Britomart McDonald's, all clear, no issues to report.
Commercial Bay all clear, no issues to report; continuing patrols back up towards Headquarters to commence break while remaining vigilant.
Arrived at Wyndham Street; standing by maintaining our presence.
Heading back to Headquarters to start break.
Break completed; standing by waiting for handover.
Night Shift completed; handing over to the Morning Shift.
